title: Baseball scores, snake-handling religions and the states he has visited
summary: After a break to hear Aaron's at-bat and a remark on religions he lists the states he has visited.

blocks.x: Yeah. What's that? Did Aaron hit a home run? Did Aaron hit another home run?
I got no ...(?)... Talking about people's religions, I don't know. But they have some awful ones. They keep a rattlesnake and let them bite them, and they worship snakes and stuff.
Yeah, almost anything you can imagine.
Yes. There's funny things in this world.
I guess you've seen practically all of the United States in...

Practically. I guess there's a few things I haven't been. I mean, I don't... I'm trying to think of where I haven't been. I haven't been to Alaska, and I don't intend to go there any more -- now. [LAUGHS] I think that's the only state I haven't been in. I didn't spend any time in North and South Dakota; I can't say I was there. But I've been there. I can't think of any states that I haven't been in. Can't think of any right offhand.
I've been in New Mexico. Yeah, I've been there, but only just driving though. I don't remember staying there.
